name: Karen Martinez

bio.statement: Forest Grove's elections page lists Councilor Karen Martinez's seat as up for election in November 2026.

verification.note: Elections page lists Councilor Karen Martinez among the four seats up in Nov 2026. The page is stale (still says filing has not opened) and does not itself say she is running; ballot/pamphlet separately confirm her candidacy.
